# I analyse data to understand Peru’s economy and improve its public policies

[I am an economist and Senior Researcher at Red de Estudios para el Desarrollo (REDES), a Peruvian policy think tank. I write about jobs, poverty, investment and public services, using national survey data and impact evaluation. Opinion columnist at *El Comercio*.]{.bajada}
